factories.name: new_list_thread_replies_step
factories.description: Read one bounded page of the replies to a channel message, with each reply's sender, time, and text converted from HTML, continuing with the returned cursor. Needs ChannelMessage.Read.All, which requires administrator consent.

inputSchema.description: ListThreadRepliesInput selects one page of replies to a channel message.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel ID, such as 19:4a95f7d8db4c4e7fae857bcebe0623e6@thread.tacv2.

cursor.description: Cursor is a previous page's NextCursor; empty reads the first page.

maxTextCharacters.description: MaxTextCharacters bounds each reply's Text from 1 to 100000 characters; zero keeps 4000.

messageId.description: MessageID is the root message's ID, such as the MessageID a postChannelMessage Result returned.

pageSize.description: PageSize is 1 to 50 replies; zero reads 20. It is ignored with a Cursor, which keeps its own size.

teamId.description: TeamID is the team's GUID, such as fbe2bf47-16c8-47cf-b4a5-4b9b187c508b.

factories.name: new_post_channel_message_step
factories.description: Post one top-level message, with an optional subject, to a channel as the signed-in user. Graph has no idempotency key, so a sync single-dispatch fence checkpoints the send across retries; an unconfirmed send is read back without another post.

inputSchema.description: PostChannelMessageInput describes one top-level channel message.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel ID, such as 19:4a95f7d8db4c4e7fae857bcebe0623e6@thread.tacv2; the channelPicker unit saves it.

content.description: Content is the message body in ContentType.

contentType.description: ContentType is text or html; blank means text.

importance.description: Importance is normal, high, or urgent; blank leaves Teams' default.

subject.description: Subject is an optional one-line plain-text subject Teams shows above the message.

teamId.description: TeamID is the team's GUID, such as fbe2bf47-16c8-47cf-b4a5-4b9b187c508b; the teamPicker unit saves it.

factories.name: new_post_thread_reply_step
factories.description: Reply once to an existing channel message's thread as the signed-in user. Graph has no idempotency key, so a sync single-dispatch fence checkpoints the send across retries; an unconfirmed reply is read back without another post.

inputSchema.description: PostThreadReplyInput describes one reply to an existing channel message.

channelId.description: ChannelID is the channel ID, such as 19:4a95f7d8db4c4e7fae857bcebe0623e6@thread.tacv2.

content.description: Content is the reply body in ContentType.

contentType.description: ContentType is text or html; blank means text.

importance.description: Importance is normal, high, or urgent; blank leaves Teams' default.

messageId.description: MessageID is the root message's ID, such as the MessageID a postChannelMessage Result returned.

teamId.description: TeamID is the team's GUID, such as fbe2bf47-16c8-47cf-b4a5-4b9b187c508b.

factories.name: new_post_chat_message_step
factories.description: Send one message to an existing one-on-one, group, or meeting chat as the signed-in user. A sync single-dispatch fence prevents a duplicate across retries; the connection cannot read chat messages, so an unconfirmed send selects uncertain.

inputSchema.description: PostChatMessageInput describes one message in an existing chat.

chatId.description: ChatID is the chat ID, such as 19:meeting_MjdhNjM4YzUtYzExZi00@thread.v2 or a one-on-one chat's 19:...@unq.gbl.spaces ID; the chatPicker unit saves it.

content.description: Content is the message body in ContentType.

contentType.description: ContentType is text or html; blank means text.

importance.description: Importance is normal, high, or urgent; blank leaves Teams' default.
